name: Vakra Tunda Mahakaya
text:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
meaning: O Ganesha, curved-trunked and vast, radiant like a million suns, please help remove obstacles from my undertakings.
purpose: A prayer for support before beginning work or a new undertaking.
supports: Planning; confidence; reducing avoidable distractions; meeting practical challenges.
when: Before a new project, study session or important task.
